Chay Denne (born December 19, 1998), known professionally as President Chay, is an American YouTuber, vlogger, and internet personality from South Carolina, he is best known for his DIY construction videos.
Career
He launched his YouTube channel on May 22, 2020, and uploaded his first video on August 18, 2021.
Personal life
Denne often makes videos with his father, Charlie, and his brother Colby Denne. In 2020, he married Kelsey Evans and is currently based in Greer, South Carolina, where he resides in a modified bus that he built.
